name: mirage
text: Version 1.0.73 is out: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.73 . A price nobody sold at now stays off the +EV list for 2 hours. It only comes back if the price moves by more than a cent. Bets refused at the slip are remembered the same way. The engine also now reports how many lines SX Bet, Kalshi and Polymarket priced, and flags any book whose prices sit far from the others', which would be a wrong match. The engine uses the matching check from its next restart. I'll read the SX numbers from the scan note and tell you what they show.
